summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of a binding term sheet for a $31.9 million non-recourse loan facility secured by Nvidia B300 GPUs. The facility is with an undisclosed institutional lender, with collateral strictly limited to the GPU assets. Proceeds will fund AI infrastructure expansion including data center build-out in Sweden. This is a financing transaction, not a special situation category; it involves no change in control, capital returns, or restructuring. The filing is a routine financing update, not a transformative corporate event. Watch for definitive documentation completion and deployment of funds for GPU installation.
